_comment: How far an Age tears its own seams open (design 3.4): scarps throw further, rifts cut deeper, walls
stand higher, and a fuzzed border widens.
Only in an Age divided into territories, since an undivided one has no seam to tear and a step here
would show nothing -- which is what it did for most Ages while it was the commonest first purchase
(Jonah, 2026-10-12). Strange: the ground is wrong, and nothing about it hurts, so it is the first thing a
barely flawed Age with seams shows.
